key_insight: OPERAG combines retrieval with large language models to code free-text job descriptions without expert-labelled training databases, supporting downstream occupational exposure assessment.
engineering_relevance: Retrieving classification-specific coding information offers a way to support occupational coding systems beyond the fixed label sets of supervised models.
method: Retrieve relevant occupational coding index information.
Use a large language model to classify job descriptions with the retrieved context.
Link occupational codes to Job Exposure Matrices for exposure assessment.
evidence_signal: On 36,062 AsiaLymph job descriptions, OPERAG achieved 42.6% fourth-level occupational coding accuracy and 89.9–98.6% exposure assessment accuracy using ALOHA+ and SHOCK.
watch_item: Fourth-level coding accuracy remains below the reported 51–56% human inter-coder reliability, and generalization across other cohorts and classifications requires further validation.
paper_title: Automatic Occupational Coding through Retrieval-Augmented Generation
